verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.truelayer.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a curated doc index, and it states that appending .md to any docs page URL returns a markdown version. Docs pages are indeed served at .md URLs, and the llms.txt entries index Console, account and security docs, so an agent can be pointed straight at machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of a consolidated llms-full.txt or explicit agent-specific usage guidance beyond the index.
